subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose `deferred` as a public persisted cron run status and plugin/CLI/UI contract for yielded-parent handoff?
rationale: The bug requires a lifecycle fix, but correctness evidence cannot decide whether the internal waiting state should become a permanent public status and plugin contract.

options.title: Adopt deferred status
options.body: Accept `deferred` as the canonical public handoff state after the correctness fix and exact-head compatibility and upgrade proof.

options.title: Keep status internal
options.body: Preserve the existing public cron status union and represent yielded waiting only through internal task and session lifecycle state.

recommendation.title: Adopt deferred status
recommendation.body: Accept `deferred` as the canonical public handoff state after the correctness fix and exact-head compatibility and upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The yielded-parent lifecycle behavior appears to originate in their prior merged work, making them the strongest available owner for the permanent contract decision.
